mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deliveryaddress (contactName, contactSex, contactTel, address, userId) VALUES (#{contactName}, #{contactSex}, #{contactPhone}, #{detail}, CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR))
mapper.select: SELECT daId AS id, CAST(userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, contactName AS contact_name, contactTel AS contact_phone, address AS detail, contactSex AS contact_sex FROM deliveryaddress WHERE userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) ORDER BY daId ASC

SELECT daId AS id, CAST(userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, contactName AS contact_name, contactTel AS contact_phone, address AS detail, contactSex AS contact_sex FROM deliveryaddress WHERE userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) AND daId = #{addressId} LIMIT 1

SELECT daId AS id, CAST(userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, contactName AS contact_name, contactTel AS contact_phone, address AS detail, contactSex AS contact_sex FROM deliveryaddress WHERE userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) ORDER BY daId ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT daId AS id, CAST(userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, contactName AS contact_name, contactTel AS contact_phone, address AS detail, contactSex AS contact_sex FROM deliveryaddress WHERE userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) AND daId = ( SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT uda.address_id FROM user_default_address uda JOIN deliveryaddress da ON da.daId = uda.address_id AND da.userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) WHERE uda.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 ), (SELECT MIN(daId) FROM deliveryaddress WHERE userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR)) ) ) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE deliveryaddress SET contactName = #{contactName}, contactSex = #{contactSex}, contactTel = #{contactPhone}, address = #{detail} WHERE userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) AND daId = #{id}
INSERT INTO user_default_address (user_id, address_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{addressId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE address_id = VALUES(address_id)
